constructionRule: Retain closed tapered frusta and closed upper-hemisphere/base-disk roofs. Rebuild the four satellites as broad bulbous buttress masses, not towers: each satellite's BASE+DRUM height to dome collar divided by maximum body width must be <=1.25. Add exactly two broad closed shoulder-bridge frusta that overlap the central lower body, central keep, and front satellite bodies, making the facade one continuous mass.
requiredHierarchy: one broad inhabited lower body with a centered facade volume
two broad shoulder bridges climbing from the lower body into the keep
two dominant front bulbous satellites fused into the bridges and two subordinate rear satellites fused into the apse
one two-stage central keep emerging from the fused body
closed hemidome roof caps whose collar widths match their thick bodies
compact crown without a needle or chimney silhouette
forbidden: micro-detail used to hide failed massing
